title: Why are people saying Cillian Murphy is Dr. Doom? The eye theory
answer: People are saying Cillian Murphy is Doctor Doom because of a fan theory that spread in late November 2026: a new Avengers: Doomsday teaser shows a brief close-up of Doom's eyes, and some viewers think they look blue, like Murphy's, rather than brown, like Robert Downey Jr.'s. Marvel's announced Doom is still Downey.
body:
The theory is about one shot. In footage from Avengers: Doomsday released around Nov. 26, 2026, Magneto, played by Ian McKellen, appears to reach for Doom's mask, and the camera lingers for a moment on the eyes behind it. Fans who paused the clip argued the eyes look pale blue or green. Downey has brown eyes, while Cillian Murphy is known for his striking blue ones, so posts arguing that someone else is under the mask spread quickly, usually along the lines of "pause on the mask scene and look at those eyes."

The idea did not come from nowhere. In 2023, after Oppenheimer, rumors that Marvel wanted Murphy for Doctor Doom circulated widely, and fan posters imagining him in the mask went viral. Then, at San Diego Comic-Con in July 2024, Marvel announced that Robert Downey Jr., who played Tony Stark for over a decade, would return as Victor von Doom. Downey and Murphy co-starred in Oppenheimer and both won Oscars for it, which makes the swap theory extra tempting for fans.

There is no confirmation. Marvel has not commented, and entertainment outlets covering the theory note it rests on a single close-up, where lighting, color grading or visual effects can change how eyes look. Some fans have gone further and suggested the film could feature two versions of Doom, one played by each actor; that is also pure speculation. Avengers: Doomsday, directed by Anthony and Joe Russo, is scheduled for theaters on Dec. 18, 2026, in the U.S., so the answer will come then.
in_the_news: A new Avengers: Doomsday teaser released around Nov. 26, 2026, showed a close-up of Doom's eyes, and fans began arguing that Cillian Murphy, not Robert Downey Jr., is under the mask.

faq.q: Is Cillian Murphy in Avengers: Doomsday?
faq.a: Marvel has not announced him. The confirmed Doctor Doom is Robert Downey Jr., revealed at San Diego Comic-Con in July 2024. The Murphy idea is a fan theory.

faq.q: Who plays Doctor Doom in Avengers: Doomsday?
faq.a: Robert Downey Jr., who previously played Iron Man. He also appeared as Doom in a mid-credits scene of The Fantastic Four: First Steps (2025).

faq.q: Why do fans think the eyes are not Robert Downey Jr.'s?
faq.a: In the teaser close-up, the eyes behind the mask look light blue or green to many viewers, while Downey's eyes are brown. Lighting and color grading can easily shift eye color on screen, so it proves little.

faq.q: When does Avengers: Doomsday come out?
faq.a: It is scheduled for Dec. 18, 2026, in U.S. theaters, with some countries getting it a day earlier.
